title: training-impact-review-subject/1
description: What a training manager signs, with password re-entry in the EDC, when accepting an independent review of a training impact plan (decision impact-review of training-signature-receipt/1). The training service produces it (GET /api/training/signature-subject?kind=impact-review&planId=...); the EDC recomputes its hash before signing. Hash: hex SHA-256 of canonical JSON (object keys sorted, arrays in order, JSON.stringify scalars), as for training-signature-subject/1. planHash is the canonical hash of the retained training-impact-plan/1 request and so covers every affected action; no learner, participant or arm id appears in the subject. The reviewer is never the proposer.

context.description: The plan's exact study, or site, scope.

reviewedRevision.description: The plan revision the review was made against (the proposed head).

sourceObservationHash.description: The EDC's native impact source observation the plan was proposed against.
